title: The Effect of Education, Economic Growth and Artificial Intelligence on Stunting
abstract: Stunting is a global health issue where a toddler's body is smaller than average due to chronic malnutrition, particularly during pregnancy or the first 1,000 days of life.This research aims to explore the factors that contribute to stunting, focusing on three variables: education (X1), economic growth (X2), and internet access (X3).Using the EViews analysis method, we investigate how changes in each variable individually and collectively impact stunting rates.Our findings indicate that a 1% decrease in education levels leads to a 4.1% rise in stunting, while a drop in economic growth correlates with a 0.007% increase in stunting.Interestingly, a 1% increase in internet access is linked to a 0.12% rise in stunting, suggesting complex social and economic dynamics.Simultaneously, when education, economic growth, and internet access are tested collectively, increases in these variables also correspond to an increase in stunting, pointing to possible interdependent factors influencing stunting rates.

title: IS EDUCATION SO IMPORTANT IN THE ERA OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE?
abstract: The article examines the role and place of artificial intelligence in the modern world, its progression and popularization, as well as the impact of artificial intelligence in the workplace, displacing a person from the labor market. In this regard, the question arises: is education so important in our time, when digitalization reigns in all spheres of life? In order to remain in demand in the labor market, it is now necessary to compete not in a man-to-man pair, but in a man-to-artificial intelligence pair, so as not to lose a source of income and not to lose importance in society. The article provides a definition of the concept of “artificial intelligence”, defines its advantages and disadvantages, evaluates the need for education in the context of the development of artificial intelligence and highlights possible scenarios for the development of the education system in the future.

title: Artificial Intelligence, Creativity, and Education : A Discursive Consideration
abstract: This article presents snapshots of the recent and current state and impact of artificial intelligence-exposition of which comprises the bulk of this paper-with the topics of creativity and education acting as conversation stimulants.Variously, information is adduced, opinions expressed, and analysis provided in a discursive and conversational manner by using a range of discussants and formats with three subjects-artificial intelligence, creativity, and education-as the intertwining topics of our exchange of ideas.Items and materials will be presented from a variety of sources and expert points of view.Our discourse proceeds in an unconventional manner, taking inspiration from our epigraph from Feynman, with authorial asides to broaden our discussion.
